duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Advanced Ritual Art
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon any 1 Ritual Monster. You must also send Normal Monsters from your Deck to the GY whose total Levels equal the Level of that Ritual Monster.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Arcana Force 0 - The Fool
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. This card cannot be changed to Defense Position, except with a card effect. When this card is Summoned: Toss a coin and gain the appropriate effect. ● Heads: Negate your card effects that target this card, and destroy them. ● Tails: Negate your opponent's card effects that target this card, and destroy them.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Athena
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: If another Fairy monster(s) is Summoned: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent. Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up Fairy monster you control to the GY, except "Athena", then target 1 Fairy monster in your GY, except "Athena"; Special Summon that target.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Battle Fader

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Copycat
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; this card's ATK/DEF become equal to that monster's original ATK/DEF.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Drastic Drop Off
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: When your opponent adds a card(s) from their Deck to their hand, including drawing: They must discard 1 of those cards.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Elemental HERO Gaia
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc:
1 "Elemental HERO" monster + 1 EARTH monster
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card is Fusion Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, its ATK is halved and this card gains the same amount of ATK.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Elemental HERO Voltic
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 of your banished "Elemental HERO" monsters; Special Summon that target.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Eria the Water Charmer
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: FLIP: Target 1 face-up WATER monster your opponent controls; take control of that target while this card is face-up on the field.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Forbidden Arts of the Gishki
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Gishki" Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute face-up monsters from anywhere on the field, whose total Levels equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. Halve the ATK of the monster Ritual Summoned by this effect. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Freed the Brave Wanderer

During your 2nd Standby Phase after this card's activation: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same name as the monster you showed, and target it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Gishki Reliever
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can target 1 other monster you control; return that target to the hand. You must control another face-up "Gishki" monster to activate and to resolve this effect.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Guardian Angel Joan

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Hand of Nephthys

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Infestation Ripples

(This Special Summon is treated as a Fusion Summon.)

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Reeze, Whirlwind of Gusto

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Steelswarm Genome

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Steelswarm Sentinel

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Vylon Element

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Vylon Stella

At the end of the Damage Step, if the equipped monster battled an opponent's monster: Destroy that opponent's monster.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Vylon Tetra
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: If this card is sent from the Monster Card Zone to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 Life Points, then target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, you can destroy this Equip Card instead.

duel terminal normal parallel rare.name: Wall of Revealing Light
duel terminal normal parallel rare.desc: Activate by paying any multiple of 1000 Life Points. Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack if their ATK is less than or equal to the amount you paid.

duel terminal rare parallel rare.name: Arcana Force EX - The Light Ruler
duel terminal rare parallel rare.desc:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 monsters you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card is Special Summoned: Toss a coin and gain the appropriate effect.
● Heads: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can target 1 card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.
● Tails: During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, that targets this card is activated: This card loses exactly 1000 ATK and you negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

duel terminal rare parallel rare.name: Steelswarm Sting

duel terminal rare parallel rare.name: Vylon Hept

duel terminal rare parallel rare.name: Vylon Sphere

1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "Gusto" monsters
 When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 "Gusto" card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. Your opponent takes any Battle Damage you would have taken from battles involving a face-up "Gusto" monster you control. This card cannot be destroyed by battle.

duel terminal super parallel rare.name: Gem-Knight Citrine

1 "Gem-Knight" monster + 1 Pyro-Type monster

1 "Gem-Knight" monster + 1 Thunder-Type monster

duel terminal super parallel rare.name: Laval Stennon

When this card is Synchro Summoned: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. During either player's turn, when this card is targeted by a card effect: You can banish 1 "Laval" monster from your Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy the targeting card.

duel terminal super parallel rare.name: Silent Swordsman LV7

1 "Vylon" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; equip that target to this card. While this card is equipped with an Equip Card, it cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap effects, except for Equip Cards.

duel terminal ultra parallel rare.name: Vylon Omega

2 Tuners + 1 non-Tuner "Vylon" monster

During either player's turn, when a monster effect activates: You can send 1 Equip Card equipped to this card to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.
